title: Retire directive health coherence checker
description: WHY: agent-directive-health.ts (382 lines) exists to verify the registry metadata stays coherent with runtime behavior - a job that disappears when directives are projections of enforcement, because the gap emitter and the registry key are the same contract and the sprint 2 and 3 tests already enforce coverage both directions. WHAT: after the inversion lands, reduce the module to whatever still earns its place (likely a registry text lint: instruction strings non-empty, nextCommand templates parse, no untrusted interpolation) and delete the coherence machinery. Check for callers in doctor and CLI health surfaces before deleting; doctor output must not regress. Record the removal rationale in the epic closeout summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Coherence-checking code paths are removed with callers updated and doctor output unchanged or deliberately improved
Any retained lint has focused unit tests
pnpm test and bwrk doctor --strict --json pass
closedReason: Directive health coherence checker retired and static lint retained.
